critical_code_review_comments: StockMasterPage useEffect debounce: load() is recreated each render -> eslint-disable-next-line is used to suppress the warning. Acceptable but consider useCallback to follow React Hooks best practices.

Reorder level input: setting value to '' (empty string) while typing is fine because save coerces with parseInt; however the input also has type='number' with min=0 - browser validation might block negative typing, which is good.

ExcelColumnFilter: when query is non-empty and user clicks Select-all, only filteredValues are toggled (correct excel behavior), but Apply checks 'working.size === values.length' to decide if filter is null - if user filters by query and partially selects, this still works (size compared to total values).
Image column filter has fixed values ['Has image','No image']; sorting on image column is correctly disabled (onSort=null).
Sort persists across filter changes (useMemo recalculates) - correct.
Minor UX: there is no visual sort indicator (caret) on the column header until user opens popover and applies sort; actually CaretUp/CaretDown render in trigger when sortDir is set. Verified working.
No pagination on /api/stock-master - acceptable for current scale (6 items).
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TST15251/TESTMAKE during edit/delete verification. Backend state restored to original 6 items.
